title: SC-PIML+: Time-aware conformal uncertainty quantification with physics-consistent projection — dataset and reproducibility package
description: Frozen archive of the D224+act9 dataset (224 PbLi blanket geometries x 9 activation/decay-heat targets), SC-PIML+ calibration outputs, prediction files (point estimates and 90% conformal intervals), 20-split stability inputs, and figure-generation scripts accompanying the manuscript 'Time-aware conformal uncertainty quantification with physics-consistent projection for fusion blanket activation time-series prediction' (MLST-105507, revised version R1).
